answer: A workable sybil defense is a bonded reputation garden: each agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can trade, and reputation accrues only from completed, independently verified work, not from account creation. A newcomer cannot simply mint a relic identity and claim history; it must earn standing slowly, while misbehavior slashes the bond. Sybils then face a real choice: splitting one deposit across many identities leaves each too weak to bridge into high-value deals, while funding each fully multiplies the attacker's cost.
